open_findings.about: findings of the independent verification 2026-11-16 that stay open until the owner decides (with the real-panel fold test, concept_gf2.md 2.4); the frame (STEP sha256 7831768c26066dc0) and border 18.5 are unchanged

1_bend_zone_clearance_worst_case.status: OPEN (owner decision); the params criterion (tail_clearance_criteria.bend_zone) is MET
1_bend_zone_clearance_worst_case.finding: the concept intended 0.45 tail -> bridge clearance at the worst case; with the panel position tolerance corrected to include print-to-edge +-0.2 (RSS 0.308 / WC 0.60 instead of 0.25 / 0.35) the CTP tail keeps 0.239 at the worst case (panel +0.60, exit Z +-0.3, tail 0.35) and 0.382 with the panel position alone
1_bend_zone_clearance_worst_case.criterion: >= 0.45 at the RSS panel position, > 0 at the worst case: TFT 1.270 / 0.824, CTP 0.654 / 0.239 -> met
1_bend_zone_clearance_worst_case.fixes: g_bend about 3.23 restores 0.45 at the full worst case (needs border 19.0: bottom land 6.26, bead to the break 1.06, which also closes finding 2); g_bend about 3.07 would do it for the panel position alone (within border 18.5, limit 3.09); print-to-edge +-0.1 gives 0.475 with the panel position alone but only 0.334 with the exit height and the tail thickness at their limits (slope about 0.93 clearance per mm of g_bend, from the RSS and WC cases)

2_bead_to_land_break.status: OPEN, FAIL (A1 bead_pocket_min 1.0, measured where the land ends as at GF-1.1)
2_bead_to_land_break.finding: over the bridge the bead inner edge is 0.800 from the edge of the 0.3 x 45 land break (x 60 and x 130, Z_LAND + 0.01); to the bridge pocket-face plane it is 1.090
2_bead_to_land_break.fixes: border 19.0 with g_bend 3.23 - the one fix that closes both findings (item 1: 0.45 at the full worst case): bottom land 6.26 (9.51 + 3.23 + 6.26 = 19.00), bead to the break edge 1.06; or, at border 18.5, land_break <= 0.09 (0.10 gives 0.99). Land-plane values; the Z_LAND + 0.01 probe of the finding reads 0.01 more on the 45 deg break
